Lemma (2^T-Periodicity): For any integer polynomial P(a,b) and any T >= 0, P(a,b) mod 2^T depends only on (a,b) mod 2^T. Proof: (x + 2^T)^i = sum_r C(i,r) x^r 2^{T(i-r)}, and every term with i > r has factor 2^T. Elementary. Reduction Corollary: to prove v_2(P(a,b)) >= T for all (a,b) with a+b ~ p mod 2, check P(a,b) mod 2^T for all (a,b) in [0, 2^T)^2 with parity p (a finite computation, 2^{2T-1} residues).

Structural theorem (Day 88, both cycles): For all 0 <= k <= 2c-1, h_k^{(c)}(a, b) factors as (a+3)_{c-1-k} * (b+2)_{c-1-k} * Q_k(a, b, c) where (x)_n is the Pochhammer symbol interpreted UNIFORMLY as a Gamma-ratio Gamma(x+n)/Gamma(x) — polynomial for n >= 0, inverse Pochhammer for n < 0 — and Q_k(a, b, c) is in Q[a, b, c] (defined uniformly by the finite-difference formula Q_k = sum_{j=0..k} (-1)^{k-j} C(k,j) (a+c-k+2)_{k-j} (b+c-k+1)_{k-j} P_j(a,b,c) for all k). Consequence: the leading coefficient D_k(c) := (top-monomial coefficient of Q_k) is polynomial in c for all k. Derivation (Cycle 1): substitute M_j = sum_mu K_{mu^T,(2^j)} R_mu(a,b,c) (Sym-side, Day 86 checked-sober) into Clio's Lemma-1 template inversion identity, telescope factorials as Gamma-ratios, cancel Vandermonde D_∅ = (a-b+1)(b-c+1)(a-c+2) against template denominators. Result (♦-ext, Cycle 2): H_c(a,b,j) = (a+3)_{c-1-j}(b+2)_{c-1-j} P_j(a,b,c) for ALL 0 <= j <= 2c-1 as a rational identity in Q(a,b,c). Boundary case (j > c-1) forces P_j to be divisible by (a+c-j+2)_{j-c+1}(b+c-j+1)_{j-c+1}; verified numerically. Then h_k^{(c)} = sum_{j=0..k} (-1)^{k-j} C(k,j) H_c(a,b,j) inherits the extended factorization via Möbius inversion.
